jailbreaks.name: bakera1n
jailbreaks.notes: Compatible with A8(X) - A11 devices. A11 devices cannot use a passcode, Touch ID, Face ID, or Apple Pay in a jailbroken state, and must have never had a password after restoring on iOS 16. NOTE: This is a developer-oriented jailbreak, end users are recommended to use palera1n instead.

jailbreaks.name: Def1nit3lyN0tAJa1lbr3akTool
jailbreaks.notes: Compatible with A11 and earlier devices. Requires TrollStore.

jailbreaks.name: Dopamine
jailbreaks.notes: Supports all devices on 15.0 to 17.3.1, as well as A13 and earlier devices on 17.4 to 18.7.1 and 26.0 to 26.0.1.

jailbreaks.name: Amethyst
jailbreaks.notes: A10(X) and earlier devices on 12.0 to 12.5.8 can *re*jailbreak with TotallyNotSpyware-v2.

jailbreaks.name: Aquila
jailbreaks.notes: Only supports 32-bit devices.

jailbreaks.name: Carbon
jailbreaks.notes: Only supports 32-bit devices. Does an untethered jailbreak on 8.0-9.3.4. 9.3.5/9.3.6 can be untethered after using carbon through the iocaste untether on LukeZGD's repository.

jailbreaks.name: checkra1n
jailbreaks.notes: Compatible with A7 - A11 devices. A11 devices on iOS 14 cannot use a passcode, Touch ID, Face ID, or Apple Pay in a jailbroken state.

jailbreaks.name: Chimera
jailbreaks.notes: A12 support is only available on iOS 12.0 - 12.1.2. A10(X) and earlier devices can *re*jailbreak with TotallyNotSpyware-v2.

jailbreaks.name: daibutsu
jailbreaks.notes: iPad 2 support limited to the 2012 WiFi-Only 16GB revision

jailbreaks.name: doubleh3lix
jailbreaks.notes: Present within TotallyNotSpyware

jailbreaks.name: EverPwnage
jailbreaks.notes: Only supports 32-bit devices.

jailbreaks.name: g0blin
jailbreaks.notes: Abandoned and superceded by doubleh3lix

jailbreaks.name: greenpois0n
jailbreaks.notes: Also compatible with iPhoneOS 3.2.2

jailbreaks.name: Home Depot
jailbreaks.notes: Untethered through add-on package, also compatible with A5(X) devices on iOS 8.4.1, also compatible with A5(X) devices on iOS 8.0 to 8.4 with the use of a patching script

jailbreaks.name: JailbreakMe 2.0
jailbreaks.notes: **Broken on iOS 4 due to TLS changes**. Not compatible with iPhoneOS 3.2.2

jailbreaks.name: JailbreakMe 3.0
jailbreaks.notes: Doesn't support 4.2.9 or 4.2.10 on iPhone 4 CDMA. iPad 2 supported only on 4.3.3

jailbreaks.name: JBMe
jailbreaks.notes: Can only rejailbreak already jailbroken devices jailbroken with Pangu933 or kok3shi

jailbreaks.name: kok3shi9
jailbreaks.notes: 32-bit support only for 9.3.2 to 9.3.6

jailbreaks.name: Legacy iOS Kit
jailbreaks.notes: Supports all 32-bit devices on 3.1.3 to 9.3.4, and the 3GS on all versions. Jailbreak is untethered except on 4.2.9, 4.2.10, and iPad 2 4.3.x where it is semi-tethered. An Arduino with USB Host Shield or Raspberry Pi Pico is required for A5(X) devices not on iOS 5.0-6.1.2.

jailbreaks.name: Lyncis
jailbreaks.notes: Only supports 32-bit devices.

jailbreaks.name: Meridian
jailbreaks.notes: Redirects to TotallyNotSpyware when pressing the jailbreak button on the Meridian website. Present within TotallyNotSpyware.

jailbreaks.name: openpwnage
jailbreaks.notes: iOS 8.4.1 can be optionally untethered via etason untether package

jailbreaks.name: orangesn0w
jailbreaks.notes: iPhone 4 only

jailbreaks.name: p0insettia
jailbreaks.notes: iPhone 5 only

jailbreaks.name: Pangu8
jailbreaks.notes: Not Functional (Dead Servers)

jailbreaks.name: PPJailbreak
jailbreaks.notes: Not Functional on OTA updated devices

jailbreaks.name: purplera1n
jailbreaks.notes: Only supports iPhone 3GS

jailbreaks.name: Pusher
jailbreaks.notes: Only supports iPhone and iPhone 3G

jailbreaks.name: PwnageTool
jailbreaks.notes: Also supports iPhoneOS 1.1.4, iPhoneOS 2.0 to 2.2.1, and tvOS 4.0 to 4.2.2

jailbreaks.name: QuickFreedom
jailbreaks.notes: Only supports iPod touch (2nd generation)

jailbreaks.name: RageBreak
jailbreaks.notes: Only supports iPhone 4

jailbreaks.name: redsn0w Lite
jailbreaks.notes: Only supports iPod touch (2nd generation)

jailbreaks.name: redTool
jailbreaks.notes: Only supports iPod touch (2nd generation)

jailbreaks.name: Socket
jailbreaks.notes: iPad 4th Generations running 10.3.2 to 10.3.4 are not untethered *by default*, and will have issues successfully booting around 7% of the time if the untether is enabled.

jailbreaks.name: sockH3lix
jailbreaks.notes: A modified version of h3lix using the superior sock_port exploit.

jailbreaks.name: TaiG
jailbreaks.notes: Not Functional (Dead Servers)

jailbreaks.name: Taurine

jailbreaks.name: tetherbootX32

jailbreaks.name: TotallyNotSpyware

jailbreaks.name: unc0ver
jailbreaks.notes: iOS 14.4 - 14.5.1 support is only available on A12+ devices with Fugu14 (Betas are not supported). iOS 14.6 to 14.8 support only available on A12 and A13 iPhones.

jailbreaks.name: Untetherizer
jailbreaks.notes: Only supports iPod touch (2nd generation)

jailbreaks.name: meowbrek2
jailbreaks.notes: Compatible with A11 and earlier devices. Requires TrollStore.

jailbreaks.name: nathanlr
jailbreaks.notes: **This is a semi-jailbreak. As a result, there are some limitations that would not exist with a full-fledged jailbreak.** Supports devices that previously *did not* support Dopamine on 16.5.1 to 16.6.1, 16.7 RC (20H18) and 17.0. Requires TrollStore.
